svg.aria-label: DS-1 developed surface sector chart with 72 addressable surface sectors
svg.title: DS1-DRG-003 — Surface Sector Nomenclature Chart

g.text: DEVELOPED SURFACE SECTOR CHART — EQUIRECTANGULAR PROJECTION
72 addressable surface sectors. Designation: <BAND>-<MERIDIAN>. Meridian index increments 030 degrees eastward from the prime reference meridian.
MERIDIAN — DEGREES EAST OF PRIME REFERENCE
1. Sector designations are the sole addressing scheme for hull work orders, damage
reports, boarding alerts and garrison deployment. Free-text location is rejected.
2. Bands N1 and S1 are trench-adjacent and inherit Zone Z4 perimeter controls.
3. Surface sectors map one-to-one onto Sector Control Nodes (DS1-ENG-011).
